title: Callaway Scoring Draft — Gross totals, golfer count input (1–64), and blank tournament titles

requirements.summary: Show a per-golfer gross total in the score entry card that updates as hole scores change and avoids incorrect totals when incomplete.
acceptanceCriteria: When a golfer has all hole scores filled with valid numbers, a gross total is shown within that golfer’s score entry card.
The gross total updates immediately when any hole score for that golfer changes.
If one or more hole scores are missing/blank, do not show an incorrect total (either hide the total or show a clear placeholder such as "Gross Total: —").

file_operations.description: Compute a derived per-golfer gross total from holeScores and render it inside each golfer card; only show a numeric total when all hole scores are present and parse to valid numbers, otherwise render a clear placeholder (e.g., "Gross Total: —").

requirements.summary: Replace the golfer count dropdown with a constrained numeric input (1–64) and block continuing when invalid.
acceptanceCriteria: The event setup form uses a numeric input for golfer count (not a dropdown/select).
The input prevents or blocks submission with values outside 1–64 (including empty, 0, negatives, or >64).
On successful submission, the score entry step initializes exactly the specified number of golfer entry cards.

file_operations.description: Replace the "Number of Golfers" Select with an Input type="number" constrained to integers 1–64 (min/max/step plus submit-time validation). Block form submission when the value is missing or out of range and keep the submitted golferCount consistent with the validated integer.

Ensure setup completion handling remains compatible with validated golferCount from the setup form so score entry initializes exactly setup.golferCount golfer cards (no additional UI changes beyond wiring/compatibility if needed).

requirements.summary: Make Tournament Title blank by default and preserve blank titles on submit without auto-filling a fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: On initial load of the event setup form, the Tournament Title input value is an empty string (no prefilled title).
Submitting the setup form with an empty Tournament Title preserves it as empty (no automatic replacement with a default title).
The app header continues to display a reasonable fallback label when the title is empty (e.g., the existing behavior showing a default app name), but the stored event title remains blank.

file_operations.description: Change the Tournament Title state default to an empty string and remove any submit-time fallback that overwrites empty titles; ensure the EventSetup passed to onComplete stores title as the trimmed user input (possibly empty).
Confirm the header continues to display a non-empty fallback label when eventSetup.title is empty, without mutating the stored event title.

requirements.summary: When event title is blank, omit the title heading in the leaderboard and PDF export while keeping PDF export functional.
acceptanceCriteria: If the event title is blank, the leaderboard title section does not show an empty large heading.
PDF export still works when the event title is blank (no empty/awkward header line in the printed output).

file_operations.description: Conditionally render the leaderboard title heading only when the provided title is non-empty after trimming; when blank, omit the large heading area (or replace it with non-title UI that does not render an empty heading line).

Adjust PDF HTML generation so that when eventTitle is blank/whitespace, the printed header does not include an empty title line (omit the <h1>), while the document metadata (HTML <title>) uses a safe fallback string to keep export functional.
